html: Envisys engineered a specialized climatic test chamber tailored for hydrogen sensor testing, incorporating stringent safety and control systems to meet high-performance requirements. This chamber includes an integrated inertization system to mitigate risks associated with hydrogen, a fire suppression system, and comprehensive gas and heat detection systems adhering to EUCAR safety standardsDownload PDF
